questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It is a popular tourist spot for watching the sunset and sunrise over the ocean.

B. Kanyakumari is a coastal town in the State of Tamil Nadu on India's southern tip.

C. It is also a noted pilgrimage site, thanks to its Bagvathi Amman Temple and Our Lady of Ransom Church, a centre of Indian Catholicism.

D. Jutting out into the Laccadive sea, the town was known as Cape Comorin during the British rule.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

First should be **B** as it gives an introduction to what Kanyakumari is. Next, it mentions more about its name. So, next will be **D.** As **C** contains the word **also,** it means that the previous sentence already describes the town. So, the correct sequence should be **BDAC.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

Let us have all the regulations__ in black and white.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. in writing.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Context of the sentence__: **The given sentence talks about to have all the regulations in writing.
 
• __Underlined Idiom__: **In black and white** means in writing, especially an agreement, contract, or other formal documents.
 __
 
• Example: *It is the intention of the two Governments to place this agreement in black and white shortly.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is "**in writing**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Its first use dates back to the 18th-century civil war of America. Both Blacks and Whites used to consider them as correct and there was a deadlock on every minor to a major issue. Every member of the race tries to provide them correctly and prove the other one incorrect which lead to the formation of the phrase "in black and white". It means that in real life situation it is not compulsory that one person is right and another person is wrong, maybe both are right in their own place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] 

**Mistake Points__**

 
• We might think that in black and white means painted in black and white and this may lead us to select the second option in the question. Be careful when dealing with such questions!

questions.question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Rudra was laughed at by all his friends when he wore his socks inside-out.

options.text: All his friends laughed at Rudra when he wore his socks inside-out.
When Rudra wore his socks inside-out all his friends were laughing at him.
All his friends will be laughing at Rudra for wearing his socks inside-out.
If Rudra wears his socks inside-out all his friends will laugh at him.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

Clearly the active form of the sentence must have **friends as the subject**. So, options 2 and 4 are incorrect. Now, the sentence is past tense, so option 1 is correct as option 3 is in the future continuous tense.

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. He would sit at the edge of her mother's bed and stare into her crib.

B. Arvind bumbled down the interminable corridor, suddenly reminded of his daughter in the days after she was born.

C. As a proportion to the fragment of life his daughter had seen, an hour was a vast sprawling space.

D. Some days he would imagine the world through her eyes and he would feel in his heart how long an hour actually was.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **BADC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**:- 

 
• **First is B **as it defines what Arvind is reminded of i.e his daughter.
 
• **Next is A** as it describes how he would stare at her and options C and D give an account of what he felt.
 
• After A it should be **D **as C clearly is followed by D because D mentions how long an hour was and **C **further explains that an hour was a vast sprawling space for his daughter.

**Therefore, the correct sequence of the paragraph is** *BADC.*
